name: lema-humanizer
description: Humanizes AI text to pass Copyleaks, GPTZero, and Turnitin with 100% human score using Lema's Actor-Critic deconstruction pipeline. Supports Agent-as-AI mode (no API keys needed) and Hybrid mode (external gpt-oss-120b API with Agent as Critic).
defaultPrompt: Run Lema humanizer on this document: prepare the blocks, rewrite them in draft.md using high burstiness, run critic, and assemble the verified document.
